history.title: MIN_GREEN_STREAK=2 entry-timing confirmation
history.subdecision: REJECTED ON 5-MINUTE REPLAY (parent entry-timing thesis UNRESOLVED)
history.dataset: July 2026 (2026-07-06 → 2026-07-31), 20-day FMP replay, current production code, cap=2, 5-minute bars
history.evidenceSummary: Requiring 2 prior green closes removed winners (ORB +21.6R->-9.0R, hod_break +2.5R->-3.8R), cut net R -66%, dropped win rate 38%->31%, and did NOT reduce losers' MAE (-4.75%->-4.83%) so the claimed entry-timing mechanism never appeared. Left the book more ticker-concentrated (top-2 47%->96%). All pre-registered reject triggers fired.
history.confidence: high (for the 5-min proxy rejection); the broader entry-timing thesis is unresolved because 5-min bars cannot observe intra-bar entry-bar death
history.reviewTrigger: 1-minute replay available -> retest entry-timing with a 1-min-native confirmation proxy

history.title: Early adverse excursion (MAE<=-0.5R within 2 min)
history.subdecision: PREDICTIVE ONLY — not actionable via a blanket -0.5R exit
history.evidenceSummary: Dipped cohort (MAE@2m<=-0.5R): 75 trades, 19% win, -37.1R realised. Blanket -0.5R exit counterfactual = -37.5R (0.4R WORSE before slippage). 14 recovering winners contribute +33.0R (avg +2.36R) and are captured by current wide-stop/scale-out management; a blanket exit destroys them. Recovery discriminators weak/tautological on a 14-trade sample.
history.confidence: prediction strong; policy value absent as posed
history.reviewTrigger: only revisit as a CONDITIONAL exit that spares fast-reclaim recoveries, with a purpose-built recovery study (current recovery N=14)

history.title: Tight (<2%) stop-width edge
history.subdecision: Largely a proxy for volatility/setup structure, not independently robust
history.evidenceSummary: Stop set at ~1.3xATR so stop-width ~ volatility proxy (median RVOL 2->4->33 across buckets). Edge reverses for break_of_structure (tight -0.8R vs wide +11.4R), holds only for opening_drive/ORB, and collapses +45.9R->+14.9R without the top-3 tickers. Not a price or RR proxy.
history.confidence: low that stop width is an independent edge
history.reviewTrigger: n/a — treat as a symptom of clean low-ATR opening-session momentum, not a lever

history.title: Remove breakeven-after-T1 (runner keeps original stop until T2)
history.subdecision: Blanket rule REJECTED on robustness; targeted variant may warrant testing
history.dataset: JULY_2026_1M_BASELINE, controlled A/B (BREAKEVEN_AFTER_T1 true vs false), pinned universe, signal parity verified
history.evidenceSummary: Removing breakeven-after-T1 nets +4.5R (marked) / +3.2R (strict-realised): +8.6R gained via T2 + 1.4R via EOD-mark, -5.5R lost as 11 runners fell to the original stop (breakeven does protect these). Positive on all three baselines and gains>losses, but robustness fails: ex-top-2 tickers flips to -0.6R, one day (2026-07-21) contributes +5.1R (>the whole net), and max drawdown worsens -19.1->-21.1R. Corrected the descriptive study: the +32.1R MFE 'forfeit' was hindsight; the realisable edge is ~7x smaller.
history.confidence: point estimate positive but fragile/outlier-dependent; not ship-worthy as a blanket rule
history.reviewTrigger: test a TARGETED variant (structure/ATR runner trail, or setup-conditioned on BOS/ORB where gains sit) rather than full breakeven removal

history.title: Broker fills authoritative over local execution state
history.dataset: 2026-08-17 live Alpaca broker evidence (CAPR partial fill) + regression TEST E
history.evidenceSummary: CAPR stop filled 575+2007@7.28 as one Alpaca order; local recorded only the first partial and believed 2007 open while broker was flat. reconcile() now adopts broker qty. Correctness invariant, not a statistical edge.

history.title: Stale sell management must terminate at broker qty zero
history.dataset: 2026-08-17 live Alpaca broker evidence (FIGR external close, WOK stop rejection) + regression TESTS C,D
history.evidenceSummary: FIGR flattened by external order 762fe788; daemon kept stale 553 open and re-submitted an expiring stop. Now: verify broker position before every sell; broker-flat => force close, no new sell, quarantine. Prevents accidental shorts on shortable names.

history.title: Only broker-verified executions enter learning
history.dataset: 2026-08-17 FIGR (external close, P&L unreconstructable) + regression TEST C
history.evidenceSummary: verifiedClosedTrades() gate: reconciliationStatus in {discrepancy,manual_review} excluded from research until human-confirmed. FIGR resolves to manual_review and is excluded. Gate installed before any live->learning pipe exists.
